profile.ja:
【20周年記念】井河アサギ
対魔忍たちを率いる総隊長にして最強の対魔忍と呼ばれる正義のくノ一。
天才的な剣術と体術、人知を超える光速のスピードが武器。
現在は政府によって設立された対魔忍養成学校・五車学園の校長を務めている。
美しくドレスアップした彼女が抱く花束は、その活躍の年月を称えたものだ。
profile.en: 【20th Anniversary】Igawa Asagi. She is the supreme commander who leads the Taimanin and is called the strongest kunoichi of justice. Her weapons are genius-level swordsmanship, martial arts, and light-speed speed. She currently serves as principal of the government-established Taimanin training school, Gosha Academy. The bouquet she holds, beautifully dressed, commemorates her years of heroic deeds.

text.ja: 対魔忍、井河アサギよ。２０周年なんて自分でもちょっと驚いてしまうわ。これからも一緒に頑張りましょう
text.en: Taimanin, Igawa Asagi here. I'm a little surprised by the 20th anniversary myself. Let's keep working together from now on.

text.ja: ありがとう。私の対魔忍２０周年をこんな形で祝ってくれるなんて感無量よ。ちょっと大げさ過ぎる気もするけどね
text.en: Thank you. I'm overwhelmed that you're celebrating my Taimanin 20th anniversary like this. It feels a bit over the top, though.

text.ja: 赤いドレスに赤い薔薇なんてなんだか照れくさいわ。……やだ、そんなにストレートに褒めないで。顔が赤くなっちゃう
text.en: A red dress with red roses is kind of embarrassing… No, don't compliment me so straight up. My face is turning red.

text.ja: ２０年か……長かったような短かったような。敵に味方、色々な人を思い出すわね。もちろん貴方も大切な一人よ
text.en: Twenty years… feels both long and short. It brings back memories of enemies, allies, all sorts of people. Of course, you're also one of the important ones.

text.ja: 最強の対魔忍の名はまだ健在だけど、そろそろ後進に譲りたくもなるわね。自信があれば名乗ってみる？
text.en: The title of the strongest Taimanin still stands, but it's about time I pass it on to the next generation. If you're confident, why don't you claim it?

text.ja: 今日だけはお祝い気分で過ごしたいわね。って言ってるそばからまた事件。せっかくだからこのまま出動するわ！
text.en: Just for today I want to celebrate. But as soon as I say that, another incident pops up. Since it's a good chance, I'll head out right away!

text.ja: こんなドレスでも結構戦えるものね。でも少しはしたなくなかった？　――もう。私らしいとか言わないで
text.en: Even in a dress like this I can fight pretty well. But wasn't I a bit… mischievous? —Enough. Don't say it's typical of me.

text.ja: ねえ、この後どこかに行かない？　最後は貴方だけに私を祝って欲しいわ。それくらいのワガママはいいでしょ？
text.en: Hey, want to go somewhere after this? I want you alone to celebrate me in the end. A little selfishness like that is fine, right?

text.ja: やああんっ、２０周年なんてっ、今までの陵辱の記憶がどんどん蘇っちゃう。イヤらしい身体が勝手に疼いちゃう！
text.en: Yaaah, the 20th anniversary… all the memories of past violations are flooding back. My lewd body aches on its own!

text.ja: お願いよっ、まだ私が知らない快感を教えてっ！　新しいアクメを刻み込んでえっ！　あなたのすごいチンポでぇえ！
text.en: Please, teach me the pleasure I still don't know! Carve a new climax into me! With your amazing cock!

text.ja: ああんっっ、子宮が悦んでるぅっ、２０周年のすごいアクメ来るぅうっっ、これからも私を可愛がってくだひゃああああいい！！
text.en: Ahh, my womb's rejoicing, the incredible 20th-anniversary climax is coming… Keep doting on me forever!!
